PatternDisposition
PatternDisposition is a bitfield value that represents actions taken by the Falcon sensor in response to malicious activity. Bit
values come from response bits and modifier bits, where response bits are actions taken or attempted, and modifier bits are
reasons the attempt was unsuccessful. If PatternDisposition’s value is 0, no response was attempted. For example:
If PatternDisposition’s value is 1040, it will be made up of 2 bits, KILL_PROCESS(16) and OPERATION_BLOCKED(1024).
Look up your value in the Most Common Bitfield for PatternDisposition table. Once you have its response and modifier bit
names, you can find their descriptions in the PatternDisposition Bit table below. Please note, your response may contain one or
more response bits.
